name: account-scans
sql: CREATE TABLE "account-scans" ("accountId" integer PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, "collection" varchar(512), "wishlist" varchar(512), "followers" varchar(512), "following" varchar(512))

name: accounts
sql: CREATE TABLE "accounts" ("id" integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, "url" varchar(512) NOT NULL, "lastProcessingDate" date, "isBusy" boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT (0), "failedCount" integer NOT NULL DEFAULT (0), CONSTRAINT "UQ_552c1c20aa3547ce59bec7abba4" UNIQUE ("url"))

name: followers
sql: CREATE TABLE "followers" ("followerId" integer NOT NULL, "followedId" integer NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("followerId", "followedId"))

name: items
sql: CREATE TABLE "items" ("id" integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, "url" varchar(512) NOT NULL, "releaseDate" date, "imageUrl" varchar(512), "lastProcessingDate" date, "isBusy" boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT (0), "failedCount" integer NOT NULL DEFAULT (0), "albumId" integer, CONSTRAINT "UQ_296d62dba3927bafd8fd0aefc22" UNIQUE ("url"), CONSTRAINT "FK_829d66d4947b53d10d511e80f4f" FOREIGN KEY ("albumId") REFERENCES "items" ("id") ON DELETE NO ACTION ON UPDATE NO ACTION)

name: items-to-accounts
sql: CREATE TABLE "items-to-accounts" ("itemId" integer NOT NULL, "accountId" integer NOT NULL, "wishlist" boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT (0), CONSTRAINT "FK_795cd497f53706b0f9267ccfe17" FOREIGN KEY ("itemId") REFERENCES "items" ("id") ON DELETE NO ACTION ON UPDATE NO ACTION, CONSTRAINT "FK_684fc77dc5328669f73f9c53dfa" FOREIGN KEY ("accountId") REFERENCES "accounts" ("id") ON DELETE NO ACTION ON UPDATE NO ACTION, PRIMARY KEY ("itemId", "accountId"))

name: items-to-tags
sql: CREATE TABLE "items-to-tags" ("itemId" integer NOT NULL, "tagId" integer NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT "FK_9d06a71bf292bd744f1f7bf3218" FOREIGN KEY ("itemId") REFERENCES "items" ("id") ON DELETE NO ACTION ON UPDATE NO ACTION, CONSTRAINT "FK_af9d7dec79b6af6dfbee5dcbde8" FOREIGN KEY ("tagId") REFERENCES "tags" ("id") ON DELETE NO ACTION ON UPDATE NO ACTION, PRIMARY KEY ("itemId", "tagId"))

name: super-tags
sql: CREATE TABLE "super-tags" ("id" integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, "name" varchar(64) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT "UQ_07c965393382b8f6b46464eae7e" UNIQUE ("name"))

name: tags
sql: CREATE TABLE "tags" ("id" integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, "name" varchar(64) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT "UQ_d90243459a697eadb8ad56e9092" UNIQUE ("name"))

name: tags-to-super-tags
sql: CREATE TABLE "tags-to-super-tags" ("tagId" integer NOT NULL, "superTagId" integer NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT "FK_98532bb607346dfdde485852469" FOREIGN KEY ("tagId") REFERENCES "tags" ("id") ON DELETE NO ACTION ON UPDATE NO ACTION, CONSTRAINT "FK_78485c5b85b89e77f0072ddfabe" FOREIGN KEY ("superTagId") REFERENCES "super-tags" ("id") ON DELETE NO ACTION ON UPDATE NO ACTION, PRIMARY KEY ("tagId", "superTagId"))
